description: Eyes-on-pixels validation: a fresh judge LOOKS AT each recorded settled still and decides whether it visibly demonstrates the requirement and is legible {met, readable}. Catches what code review, DOM assertions, and even axe miss (dead controls, poor contrast, wrong-moment frames). Pairs with record-demos + check-recordings; on any miss, fix -> re-record -> re-verify until met.

No negative XP, timer, streak or leaderboard. Czech UI, legible in the light theme.
At the top rank HQ shows the 5th rank 'Legenda', 1 600 XP, a full XP bar and the words 'Nejvyšší hodnost!' with no 'do hodnosti' next-rank target.

A rank-up celebration on HQ names the new rank: 'Nová hodnost!', the rank name 'Kadet' in a large display face, the sentence 'Postoupila jsi na hodnost Kadet. Under reduced motion the rank-up celebration is shown as a static message with the same text ('Nová hodnost!', 'Kadet', 'Postoupila jsi na hodnost Kadet. Jen tak dál!') and the rank medal, fully visible and legible (nothing faded, half-drawn or mid-animation).

On the task screen a correct answer shows 'Výborně!' with a '+10 XP' sticker, and the rank-up celebration naming the new rank 'Kadet' appears with the feedback, above the 'Další úloha' button; no negative XP anywhere.

The mission-complete screen titled 'Mise je splněná!' shows the XP earned in the run ('+35 XP' sticker and 'Získala jsi 35 XP.'), the first-try count ('1 na první pokus'), the number of tasks ('Úloh v misi: 2'), no rank-up, and the actions 'Zpět na HQ' and 'Zopakovat misi'. FR-38: every XP figure is a positive award ('+35 XP'); no negative XP, minus sign or '+0 XP' anywhere.
The mission-complete screen shows '+30 XP', '1 na první pokus' and the rank-up celebration with the new rank name 'Kadet' ('Nová hodnost!', the medal and the sentence), legible.

After a replay of a completed mission, the screen 'Opakování je hotové!' says 0 XP were earned because a replay earns no XP ('Získané XP: 0. Za opakování se XP nepřipisují…'), shows the first-try count, and offers 'Zpět na HQ' and 'Zopakovat misi'; the wording is kind, not punishing. FR-32: it is the mission-complete screen of that run, showing the XP earned (0), the first-try count and the number of tasks.
